name: HIGH-VIX armed contrarian long — extreme-fear + VIX double-gauge confluence
rationale: Thesis: a real cross-asset capitulation prints when crypto's own Fear&Greed is in its fear band (lt fear_floor) AND equity VIX is elevated (gt vix_floor) at the same time — two independent fear gauges agreeing is rarer and higher-conviction than either alone. Both BOUNDED, mean-reverting, lowest-turnover member of this family. Exit when sentiment recovers above greed_exit OR risk/time stops. Disconfirmer 1 (does confluence beat the singles?): the standalone Fear&Greed-only and VIX-only contrarian longs are in the cohort — if neither the AND-confluence improves deflated Sharpe over the better single, the composite is just over-fitting two filters. Disconfirmer 2 (trade count): two extremes at once is rare; too few trades is honest insufficient-evidence. Disconfirmer 3 (holdout): purged+embargoed recent slice must stay positive.
catalyst: crypto Fear&Greed in fear band AND equity VIX elevated simultaneously
